candidate.detailsJudgement: Cross contours, chimney notch, arm widths and both colors reproduce the source vector exactly under the uniform transform; no lost strokes or satellite details at 240px and at 24/32/48px diagnostics.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Emblem occupies a centered box similar to the accepted icon's placement; complete emblem survives inside the circle with clear margins on both themes; legible at small sizes.
candidate.rationale: Existing icon is the outdated gable-cross presentation (pale yellow circle, black square frame, outlined two-tone cross). The current official mark is the squared-colour variant: solid #FEE600 field with solid #2B2D33 cross, served by the official RBI brand portal and corroborated by rb.cz.
candidate.role: standalone bank brand mark (gable cross emblem), no wordmark
transforms: Uniform scale 0.1074 and translation of the whole emblem to center it on the catalog circle; no rotation, stretch or path edits
Backing: the uniform #FEE600 source field fills the catalog circle with transparency outside (plain-field circle rule); no emblem pixels masked
Optimization: SVGO 4.1.0 with repo svgo.config.mjs (sha256 f2a406e0...) trial produced 658 B vs 518 B working bytes with pixel-identical render (Pillow diff bbox None); working version retained
candidate.variant: Gable Cross 'squared colour' variant (solid #FEE600 field, solid #2B2D33 cross), matching rb.cz homepage emblem and the official Gable Cross.zip Squared-Col variant
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: Base shows the obsolete framed, outlined two-tone cross; final shows the current solid squared-colour cross without the frame — a clearly visible supported rebranding/presentation correction.

proposals.reason: Existing icon shows an outdated gable-cross presentation (yellow #fdeb3f circle, black square frame, outlined two-tone cross). The mark in use today by Raiffeisenbank (CZ) and the RBI group is the 'Gable Cross — squared colour' variant: solid #FEE600 square with solid #2B2D33 cross, no frame or outline. Supported rebranding/geometry correction justifies the update.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Official RBI brand portal favicon.svg is a self-contained original vector of the current squared-colour Gable Cross (#FEE600 square, #2B2D33 solid cross), byte-corroborated by the official Gable Cross.zip 'Squared-Col' variant (PDF-verified colors) and by the inline SVG emblem colors/geometry (#fee600/#2b2d33) on the rb.cz homepage. The CZ bank publishes no standalone SVG on rb.cz itself.
